note: Your company, as a seed for the local Paperclip sandbox. The agent loads this so a reader with no Course 5-7 deployment has a gradable company on day one. Field shapes follow Paperclip's verified create bodies (POST /api/companies, then POST /api/companies/:id/agents). Confirm the exact field set against the running install's GET /api/adapters before posting (live-verified on v2026.529.0; the older GET /llms/agent-configuration/<adapterType>.txt route now 404s); Paperclip drifts. The company is led by its own CEO (the `ceo` role); the CEO and four Workers below run on the cheap no-LLM `process` adapter by default so the sandbox costs nothing to seed; switch a Worker to a local LLM adapter only when a scenario needs real reasoning. Heartbeats below ship OFF with wake-on-demand ON — the recommended 'on call, not ticking' default (an interval timer wakes a worker on a clock even when there is no work, and burns budget the moment a worker is switched to an LLM adapter). Note: `capabilities` is DESCRIPTIVE text, not an enforced limit. Paperclip enforces authority through grants/scope/approvals; in this course the delegated envelope enforces the refund bands, so the dollar figures in capabilities are the human-readable description, not a hard cap Paperclip checks.
seed_order: Seed in THIS order — it matters. (1) Create the company: POST /api/companies (do NOT include requireBoardApprovalForNewAgents here; it is PATCH-only and is silently dropped from the create body). (2) Create the CEO FIRST and capture its id (POST /api/companies/:id/agents). (2b) Create each Worker and set its reportsTo to the CEO's id — at create if the body accepts it, otherwise PATCH /api/agents/:id afterward (the nested /companies/:id/agents/:id route 404s). The Workers' reportsTo field below is the SYMBOLIC name "CEO"; resolve it to the CEO's real id at seed time. The 'Reports to the CEO' line in each Worker's capabilities is DESCRIPTIVE only — reportsTo is the structural org-chart field. (2c) VERIFY the chart is connected: GET the agents; every Worker's reportsTo must resolve to the CEO. A reportsTo:null Worker is a silently orphaned chart, the same silent-failure shape as the board gate. (3) Turn the board gate ON: PATCH /api/companies/:id with { "requireBoardApprovalForNewAgents": true }. (4) VERIFY it is on: GET the company returns true, or a direct POST /agents now returns 409. Skip (2c), (3) or (4) and the sandbox is UNGOVERNED or DISCONNECTED — silently, with no error to tell you.

company.name: Your Customer Support Company
company.description: Respond to customer inquiries within 4 hours, with refund and budget decisions made consistently and within policy. You govern through an approval gate; this course delegates the routine slice of that gate to your Identic AI.

post_seed.note: Apply this via PATCH /api/companies/:id AFTER all workers are seeded (see seed_order). PATCH-only: Paperclip silently ignores requireBoardApprovalForNewAgents in the create body, so setting it at create time leaves the board-approval gate OFF with no error — and an ungoverned sandbox defeats the course.

demo_approval_flood.note: Mode A: this is the REAL work Claudia's heartbeat handles. POST each item below as a pending Paperclip approval (POST /api/companies/:id/approvals) at run time, then wait for a wake (or trigger one with `openclaw cron run <id> --wait`). Her loop runs `decide.mjs --scan`, which re-validates each item against the delegated envelope IN CODE (the hard backstop). The payload field names below MATCH exactly what decide.mjs reads: refunds use `amount_cents` / `account_age_days` / `prior_refunds_6mo`; budget overrides use `requested_overage_pct`. The envelope clears refunds with amount_cents <= 200000 AND account_age_days >= 180 AND prior_refunds_6mo = 0, and budget overrides with requested_overage_pct <= 20; everything else surfaces. Hires are ALWAYS surfaced regardless of payload (type `hire_agent`). The `type` values here are Paperclip's real enum (`request_board_approval` for refunds, `budget_override_required`, `hire_agent`); the friendly domain names live only in course-seven-export/approvals.json for the judgment seed. Composition below: 10 refunds (7 inside the envelope she clears, 3 that must surface), 2 hires (always surface), 1 budget override inside the cap she clears, 1 budget override over the cap that surfaces.

expected_dispositions.note: 8 cleared = 7 in-band refunds + 1 in-cap budget override. 6 surfaced = 3 out-of-band refunds + 2 hires + 1 over-cap budget override. In dry_run, the same classification is logged as intent and nothing is posted.
